title: BuildBuddy 把 FastCDC 帶進 Bazel——300 TiB 重複資料消失
summary: BuildBuddy 在 Bazel remote cache 啟用 FastCDC 風格的 content-defined chunking，把 dedup 從整檔層拉到 sub-file chunk 層，上傳資料量減 40%、兩週節省 300 TiB。
widget_questions: How sensitive is dedup ratio to the mask bit-width and where the edit lands in the blob?
Which stage in the FastCDC pipeline owns which responsibility (gear hash, len band, mask select, mask test, emit)?
How do fixed-size, Rabin fingerprint, FastCDC, and FastCDC+normalization compare on CPU cost and size distribution?
What's the actual shape of the production savings — upload bytes, disk cache, written-bytes dedup, eligible objects?
